name: neurawork-harness
description: Repo-local, self-maintaining CLAUDE.md + knowledge harness for Claude Code.

plugins.name: neurawork-cc-harness
plugins.description: Three independently installable skills: knowledge-compiler (per-repo knowledge base) + claudemd-lerner (keeps CLAUDE.md hierarchy + docs/ current) + compliance-compiler (distils GDPR/SOC2/ISO27001 into a constraint catalog, derives the capabilities and stack components they require, and validates PRP plans against both). Interactive recon + brownfield seed on install. Plus two install-free workflow surfaces: /nw-worktree (create + enter a Hand worktree) and /nw-ship-pr (commit → push → PR → review → approval gate → merge → cleanup).
